title: ACadRust failure-mode and Open CAD Studio consumer-route reconciliation
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan-only refinement
scope: Refresh current open-source peer failure modes for Binary DXF serialization, legacy code pages, table conversion, named colors, XDATA, and native interpretation
Cross-check peer reports against existing local writer guards and focused tests without importing peer-specific format assumptions
Assess Open CAD Studio as an optional downstream app/kernel route with explicit parser-lineage and evidence limits
Add implementation-ready gates without increasing per-slice validation frequency or changing support claims

method.kind: Read project-owned GitHub issues, README/docs, manifest pins, and relevant local source/test declarations
method.limitations: Peer issue reports are version/reporter scoped and are not independent reproductions of libdxfrw defects or format rules. Open CAD Studio's current documentation is mutable; its manifest pins codec/kernel dependencies but the release artifact was not run or hashed. The app shares the opencadcodec/ACadRust parser lineage, and its same-codec save/reopen cannot independently qualify its writer. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG layout; Autodesk references remain authoritative for documented DXF grammar. No support claim or DEFERRED_EXTERNAL item is promoted.

sources.observed: The report identifies wrong primitive widths at Binary-DXF call sites (including I16/I32 examples) that desynchronize later tags, says the peer's own reader accepts its output, and describes an embedded-NUL XDATA string truncation. These are peer-specific allegations, not local findings. Local source inspection found value-kind guards before binary primitive emission and an embedded-NUL rejection test; this research pass did not run the local tests or exhaustively audit every serializer call site.

sources.project: ACadRust cross-format table and metadata reports
sources.revision: Open issues accessed 2026-10-18; #132 reproduction names 0.6.3/main and records a maintainer retest request after a linked commit
sources.observed: #130 reports DWG/DXF field divergence for 2010+ table merged ranges and title/header suppression. #132 reports loss of unknown custom records, named entity colors, and table/block-record XDATA on DXF-to-DWG paths; the report itself points to different codec loss locations and is not a current-release reproduction. Existing local table, named-color, raw-class, and XDATA owners were mapped rather than duplicated.

sources.project: ACadRust text and legacy code-page reports
sources.revision: Open issues accessed 2026-10-18; #125 names 0.6.3 and a main revision; #131 opened 2026-10-11
sources.observed: #125 alleges a TEXT group-51 radian/degree conversion bug in the peer; local focused source/test coverage already checks degrees in ASCII and Binary DXF. #131 enumerates legacy code-page mappings alleged wrong in ACadRust; local code classifies several such mappings as unavailable rather than silently using a nearby exact mapping. No peer encoding table was treated as authoritative.

sources.revision: Open issue accessed 2026-10-18; reproduction reports ACadRust 0.6.0 and source observation at 0.6.1
sources.observed: The report says the peer's own reader recovers explicit transparency that a CAD application's properties panel displays as ByLayer, with application/version not fully identified and the method-byte cause marked as suspected. It supports separating native interpretation from same-codec readback; it does not establish the correct libdxfrw byte value.

sources.revision: Mutable main documentation accessed 2026-10-18; Cargo manifest pins opencadcodec revision 5d4f11a and opencadkernel revision a60f18f
sources.observed: The app advertises a headless audit/save_verified route with entity manifests, dropped-on-save reporting, target-version checks and same-app reopen, and documents ACIS-to-kernel-body meshing with incomplete fallback marking. It provides an optional downstream consumer route and candidate source-distinct geometry kernel, but shares codec lineage with ACadRust through opencadcodec. No binary, app artifact, kernel operation, or result was executed here.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-39/7X Binary-DXF primitive/code-width admission and caller propagation
TABLE/ACAD_TABLE merged-range and style-flag cross-format closure
Named-color/DBCOLOR, table-record XDATA, and unknown-class source disposition
Legacy code-page explicit availability and no-silent-alias policy
Native consumer/application interpretation versus same-codec roundtrip
assessment.planImpact: Adds targeted regression details to existing writer, encoding, graph/loss, table, and consumer owners. Adds Open CAD Studio as an optional composed application/kernel route with its codec-lineage and same-codec-reopen limits; it cannot replace FreeCAD qualification or establish broad DWG/DXF/ACIS support.

implementationReadyChecks: For Binary DXF, assert each low-level primitive/code type match, no bytes emitted for an invalid primitive/code pair, correct next-record alignment, and serializer failure propagation for a representative local family.
For merged tables, compare DWG-to-DXF and DXF-to-DWG fields independently: anchor/span/covered cell state and title/header suppression; include a following-record sentinel.

For custom/raw records, named colors, and table/block XDATA, report per-source-handle typed/raw-retained/transformed/omitted/refused disposition and reference closure; never silently treat absence as preservation.
Keep unsupported legacy code-page names explicitly unavailable until exact mappings are implemented from an authoritative source with distinct decode and encode vectors.

At the existing optional Open CAD Studio checkpoint, pin app artifact, opencadcodec/opencadkernel revisions, OS, route and target version; use scratch-generated controls, collect diagnostics/manifests/drop disposition and geometry metrics separately, and keep all output temporary.

Do not use Open CAD Studio's own save/reopen as independent writer evidence, count its codec fork as an independent ACadRust parser lineage, substitute it for FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification, or promote J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295.
